subject.title: [Feature]: Matrix QA lifecycle parity across Tuwunel and Crabline

question: Should the Matrix QA lifecycle parity work proceed through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101055, including its package-root QA Matrix lifecycle API exports?
rationale: The requested behavior is a new QA infrastructure capability and the linked PR exposes a new plugin API surface; automation can verify the current gap but should not choose that permanent API boundary for maintainers.

options.title: Proceed With Linked PR
options.body: Review and land the linked lifecycle PR if maintainers accept its shared lifecycle contract and package-root API exports.

options.title: Keep Helpers Internal
options.body: Ask the linked PR to keep lifecycle helpers private to QA tests until a public QA Matrix API is explicitly needed.

options.title: Redirect Scope
options.body: Close or rewrite the linked PR if maintainers want lifecycle parity handled in a different QA host or plugin boundary.

recommendation.title: Proceed With Linked PR
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked lifecycle PR if maintainers accept its shared lifecycle contract and package-root API exports.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the tracker, the current implementation PR, and recent Matrix QA adapter work that this feature builds on.
